sentences.en: Please keep your language decent while my parents are here.
sentences.zh: 请在我父母在这里的时候保持礼貌。

sentences.en: I can't find a decent place to eat around here.
sentences.zh: 我找不到这里有什么像样的餐馆。

sentences.en: The dumb masses believe that Mandela was a decent man.
sentences.zh: 愚昧的人认为曼德拉是个正派人。

senses.zh: 像样的，尚好的；得体的，合宜的；<非正式>穿好衣服的；正派的，规矩的；待人宽厚的，和善的
